scope: Exactly six complete new position controls each for Sixian Hakka PFS and Taiwanese POJ. All original values read against the English source, not merely the paired Han text. This does not review or repair unrelated historical catalogue strings.
method: Manual whole-value linguistic and semantic review, with context-selected primary lexical checks. MOE HRS/Tâi-lô readings were manually related to PFS/POJ in the relevant lexemes; no automatic character converter or whole-language transliterator was used. Individual dictionary attestations alone were not treated as complete-sentence proof.

entries.note: Precision plus position is retained. 精 in the official syllable material and 確 kog2 support Chîn-khok with aspiration. The modern precision label is compositionally acceptable; no exact full PFS compound entry was retrieved, so confidence is moderate rather than catalogue-history-based certainty.

entries.target: X vi-chṳ (tui chó-phién hí-son ke siong-su)
entries.note: Complete label preserves X position and physical left-origin pixel counting. 左片 and position reading are supported; hí-son is transparent counting-from construction rather than a claimed dictionary quotation.

entries.target: Y vi-chṳ (tui táng-poi hí-son ke siong-su)
entries.note: Complete label preserves Y position and upper-edge pixel counting. Exact táng-poi spelling reflects supported dang31 boi55. The counting-from construction has the same bounded compositional acceptance as X.

entries.target: Sat-thin yá chông thù-siong chó-song-kok chhai sû-chhut fa-pu ke vi-chṳ. X lâu Y yung chṳ́n-su siong-su lòi son, tui làng khôi-sṳ́. Nang-ngoi ke thù-siong voi liù tén yá-ha ke vi-chṳ. Yá-vi cho-tet chhiùng-thia̍p; kha-heu fi-ngi̍p ke thù-siong voi fa chhai táng-poi. Fa-pu voi pien thai, pûn só-yû piong hó ke thù-siong tû piong tet lo̍k. Chhài-chhiet lâu chhak-chhun m̀-voi kói.
entries.note: Full paragraph reviewed clause by clause. Imperative setting, integer pixels from zero, other images retaining current positions, permitted overlap, later-imported images above, expansion fitting every placed image, and unchanged crops/dimensions are all retained. pûn + subject + tû + piong tet lo̍k is a purpose/capacity clause, not an instruction to reposition other images. Nang-ngoi and pien thai are legitimate clause-level choices. New checks resolve chhiùng-thia̍p, Sat-, fi-, khôi-sṳ́, yá-ha, and chhak-chhun; technical compounds and topic-style drawn-on-top clause remain source-assisted modern prose, with moderate idiom confidence and no native-speaker claim.

entries.source: X and Y must be whole numbers from zero to 2147483647.
entries.target: X lâu Y oi he 0 to 2147483647 ke chṳ́n-su.
entries.note: Must/be integer construction retains both coordinates, both endpoints and inclusive valid range. Contextual math chṳ́n-su is supported; the older repair/modify reading is not adopted.

entries.source: The selected image is no longer in this assembly.
entries.target: Kién tó ke thù-siong yî-kîn mò chhai yá chak phîn-chiap tú.
entries.note: The complete selected-image/no-longer-present meaning is recoverable and the resultative tó is appropriate, but yî-kîn gives the wrong tone for 已經 in this PFS usage. Authored primary PFS supports yí-kîn. Omission of a final change-of-state particle does not by itself lose the already-absent state conveyed by yí-kîn mò chhai. Revise that tone and independently reread the full replacement; source history is not acceptance.
Complete precise-position label is supported by the full precision compound tsing-khak, manually rendered in POJ. Not an automatic substitution of a Mandarin or another Taiwanese reading.

entries.target: X ūi-tì (tùi tò-chhiú-pêng khí-sǹg ê siōng-sò͘)
entries.note: Complete label has X position and pixels counted from the physical left. tò-chhiú-pêng reflects the attested full side term; khí-sǹg is a transparent origin/counting construction.

entries.target: Y ūi-tì (tùi téng-koân khí-sǹg ê siōng-sò͘)
entries.note: Complete label has Y position and pixels counted from the upper edge. téng-koân reflects the attested term and POJ orthography; no axis or direction reversal.

Overlap is allowed here; images imported later are drawn on top. The canvas expands to include all placed images. Crops and sizes stay unchanged.
entries.target: Siat-tēng chit tiuⁿ tô͘-phìⁿ chó-siōng-kak tī su-chhut ōe-pò͘ ê ūi-tì. X kah Y ēng chéng-sò͘ siōng-sò͘ lâi sǹg, tùi lêng khai-sí. Kî-tha tô͘-phìⁿ ē lâu leh chit-má ê ūi-tì. Chit ūi ē-tàng sio-tha̍h; khah āu hōe-ji̍p ê tô͘-phìⁿ ē ōe tī téng-koân. Ōe-pò͘ ē khok-tāi, hō͘ só͘-ū khǹg hó ê tô͘-phìⁿ lóng khǹg ē lo̍h. Chhâi-chhiat kah chhioh-chhùn bē kái.
entries.note: Every source clause is semantically present. The reviewed Taiwanese construction for sizes is chhùn-chhioh; draft chhioh-chhùn follows Mandarin compound order. MOE supplies the full target-language term, and a primary technical-terminology paper explicitly retains that reversed order for dimensions outside clothing. Require this narrow lexical revision for the present idiom threshold, without claiming every modern loan in Mandarin order is intrinsically impossible. The remaining whole paragraph, including ē lâu leh current positions and hō͘ ... lóng khǹg ē lo̍h capacity, is acceptable at moderate idiom confidence. Full replacement still needs independent rereview.

entries.note: Whole range-validation sentence preserves obligatory integer coordinates from 0 through 2147483647. chéng-sò͘ is the contextual mathematical reading.

H1.title: MOE Hakka dictionary: 左片
H1.supports: Four Counties zo31 pien31, physical left side; manually rendered chó-phién in PFS.

H2.title: MOE Hakka dictionary: 頂背
H2.supports: Four Counties dang31 boi55, upper side; manually rendered táng-poi, with spatial 背 poi rather than carrying-reading pà.

H3.title: School-hosted subject terminology: Hakka mathematics
H3.supports: Page 23 (zero-indexed 22), item 374: integer 整數 ziin31 su55, including zero; page 2, item 19: spatial 上 song55 in 上底. Text extraction read; screenshot retrieval returned a cache miss, so page image was not verified.

H4.title: MOE Hakka dictionary: 整, repair reading and cross-reference
H4.supports: Distinguishes repair/modify zang31 from linked ziin31 reading. The context-specific math compound is independently supplied by H3. Direct retrieval of linked record 16895 failed.

H5.title: MOE Hakka dictionary: 著, resultative
H5.supports: Four Counties do31 is the postverbal resultative reading; selected/obtained uses Kién tó, rather than copying the old catalogue’s inconsistent cho̍k/chho̍k readings.

H6.title: MOE Hakka dictionary: 這位
H6.supports: Four Counties ia31 vi55 for here; manually rendered Yá-vi. The returned page includes all dialects; the Four Counties block, not the selected Hailu block, was used.

H7.title: MOE Hakka spelling handbook
H7.supports: Indexed Four Counties syllable table gives 零 in lang, yangping; manually rendered làng. Dictionary HRS notation is not itself PFS.

H8.title: MOE Hakka dictionary: transcription principles
H8.supports: Contextual readings, literary/colloquial distinctions, and special readings must be resolved before romanization.

H9.title: MOE Taiwan Hakka spelling system
H9.supports: HRS phonemic notation used by consulted lexical sources. PFS spellings are manually authored in the project’s existing convention, not claimed to be supplied by this HRS source.

N1.title: MOE Taiwanese dictionary: 倒手爿
N1.supports: Physical left side tò-tshiú-pîng, manually expressed in catalogue POJ as tò-chhiú-pêng.

N2.title: MOE Taiwanese dictionary: 頂懸
N2.supports: Upper side tíng-kuân, manually expressed in POJ as téng-koân.

N3.title: MOE Taiwanese dictionary: 相疊
N3.supports: sio-tha̍h denotes layers one above another; this supports overlap wording rather than a vague image association.

N4.title: MOE Taiwanese dictionary: 擴 compounds
N4.supports: 擴大 is khok-tāi, retained as a full compound; not guessed as khok-tōa by changing 大 separately.

N5.title: School-hosted subject terminology: Taiwanese mathematics
N5.supports: Page 23 (zero-indexed 22), item 374 gives tsíng-sòo for integer including zero; manually expressed in POJ as chéng-sò͘. Text extraction read; screenshot retrieval returned a cache miss, so page image was not verified.

N6.title: MOE Taiwanese dictionary: 囥佇 examples
N6.supports: khǹg means place/keep, and khǹg tī expresses position. The newly composed capacity clause khǹg ē lo̍h needs full-sentence review.

H10.title: MOE Hakka: 重疊
H10.supports: Full Four Counties compound qiung11 tiab5, including permission/stacking example. Supports PFS chhiùng-thia̍p; this is independent of catalogue history.

H11.title: MOE Hakka: 尺寸
H11.supports: Four Counties full compound cag2 cun55 for dimensions; supports PFS chhak-chhun.

H12.title: MOE Hakka: 設計
H12.supports: Four Counties 設 sad2. Together with 定 tin55 in the official appendix, supports Sat-thin in the modern setting compound; the full technical compound is contextual composition.

H13.title: MOE Hakka: 匯錢
H13.supports: First Four Counties block has fi55. Supports fi- in technical fi-ngi̍p; financial entry alone does not attest importing an image.

H14.title: MOE Hakka: 開始
H14.supports: Four Counties koi24 sii31 (variant cii31) supports khôi-sṳ́ in the zero-origin clause.

H15.title: MOE Hakka: 這下
H15.supports: Four Counties ia31 ha55 supports yá-ha as current/now.

H16.title: MOE Hakka official appendix
H16.supports: First Four Counties column: 確 kog2 and 確定 kog2 tin55; HRS k is aspirated, giving PFS khok. Does not directly attest full 精確 compound.

H17.title: 六堆客家人, 曾貴海; PFS by 邱淑華
H17.supports: Authored primary PFS text, credited and dated 2009-03-08, spells 已經 as yí kîn (line 61 in retrieved text). Supports acute yí rather than draft circumflex yî, independently of historical UI terminology.

H18.title: Hakka Affairs Council basic Four Counties vocabulary
H18.supports: Item 1-312 printed p21 supplies synonym 既經 gi55 gin24; p22 supplies 這下 and directional/durative constructions. This is supplementary semantic/register evidence, not the source of the yí correction.

N7.title: MOE Taiwanese precision and integer terms
N7.supports: Explicit full compounds 精確 tsing-khak and 整數 tsíng-sòo; manual POJ Cheng-khak and chéng-sò͘. Resolves precision term independently of catalogue history.

N8.title: MOE Taiwanese: 像
N8.supports: Literary siōng appropriate to nominal image/technical pixel compound, distinct from colloquial tshiūnn. Does not establish a complete software paragraph.

N9.title: MOE Taiwanese: 揀
N9.supports: Colloquial kíng and example kíng-tio̍h support selected Kéng tio̍h in POJ.

N10.title: MOE Taiwanese: 拼
N10.supports: phing -> POJ pheng in technical pheng-chiap, without mechanically substituting other readings.

N11.title: MOE Taiwanese: 裁
N11.supports: tshâi -> POJ chhâi confirms aspirated initial in crop compound Chhâi-chhiat.

N12.title: MOE Taiwanese: 寸尺
N12.supports: Full native dimensions term tshùn-tshioh, manually POJ chhùn-chhioh, with measuring-size example.

N13.title: 蔡安理, 天文學名詞的台語新詞創制原則, 台灣學誌23
N13.supports: Printed p179, table25, explicitly treats Mandarin 尺寸 versus Taiwanese 寸尺 as reversed-order technical vocabulary, with POJ apparent-size/angular-size compounds. Relevant evidence that native dimensions order applies beyond clothing. The research paper does not certify the new UI help paragraph.

N14.title: MOE Taiwanese: 留
N14.supports: lâu covers retain/stay/preserve. The complete current-position clause was evaluated compositionally, not claimed as an attested quote.
